title: Body Temperature Changed Across Eras, Sexes, And Measurements
hook: The familiar normal temperature hides both biological change and measurement error.
closing: One historic number cannot capture how normal body temperature varies and changes.
question: What temperature feels normal to you?

segments.say: Men born in the 1990s average 97.5 degrees. Body temperature is lower than the historic figure.
Men's average temperature fell 1.06 degrees. The decline was larger than the one measured in women.
The original figure recalculates to 98.2 degrees. Measurement also explains why the old standard no longer fits.
